name: Select Expiry
description: Helper keyword used inside Find Strike(...) to specify which expiry bucket and offset to search within.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: 0 = current expiry of that type, 1 = next, etc.

note: No official Tradetron docs/OCR capture existed for this keyword in the source scrape; schema derived from its real usage as the 2nd param of Find Strike(...) across strategies/examples (e.g. Select Expiry('week', 0)).
